messages:
Noah Price: Heads-up — Wylder renewal talks. Procurement asks to convert a 10% list discount into an "enablement stipend" to be shown on the renewal invoice. They say adoption is the issue.
Mia Chen: Adoption snapshot: 55% seats onboarded, only ~30% using the core workflow. SSO cert still blocking bulk provisioning.
Priya Singh: Procurement wants stipend applied to renewal invoice (not a standalone SOW). They prefer fixed scope: up to 10 seats + 8 hours of services.
AJ Patel: Finance: fine with invoice credit if we have Delivery & Acceptance milestones and no refund liability. Need to avoid revenue deferral — suggest a 6-mo commitment on net-new spend or a minimum usage clause if we extend term.
Noah Price: Product asks for CSV seat-mapping import as a quick fix. If we can ship in 3 weeks adoption improves. Product ETA?
Priya Singh: Product can do L0 scoping today. If dev <2 weeks we can aim for a 7/12 ship.
Mia Chen: Trainer availability? We need dates to tentatively hold.
ops-bot: Trainers available 7/15 + 7/22 afternoons. We require PO line item and signed acceptance checklist before applying credit.
Priya Singh: Draft amendment language: 
`Customer shall receive a one-time invoice credit equal to an enablement stipend (up to 10 seats and 8 professional services hours). Credit applied against the renewal invoice upon delivery and Customer acceptance of training deliverables (recording, attendee list, signed acceptance checklist). Credit is non-transferable and non-refundable.`
AJ Patel: Add agreed contingency: if CSV import not delivered by X date then parties will revert to a 3-month prorate credit instead. Also add minimum committed spend if we extend term.
Mia Chen: Legal — recordings and any customer data used in training: do we need explicit consent? @legal-bot
legal-bot: Yes, recordings require express consent; demoing customer data needs a short Data Use addendum. I'll draft two paragraphs: "Training Recording Consent" and "Limited Data Use". ETA 6 hours.
Noah Price: Procurement also asked that the credit be visible on the invoice lines for their accounting team. Ops — any issue?
ops-bot: We can surface the credit as an invoice line if procurement supplies PO referencing the credit line. We apply credit after acceptance checklist processed.
Priya Singh: Suggest we include acceptance checklist template in the amendment to avoid disputes. Also require attendee roster + recording.
AJ Patel: I'll model two scenarios in $: (1) apply enablement stipend + 6-mo min spend vs (2) 3-mo prorate refund. Will post numbers by EOD.
Mia Chen: I'll pause sending countersign to procurement until legal addendum + finance guardrails are final. If both approve, I'll send amendment + addendum + checklist and ask for countersignature.
Noah Price: Procurement asked for a fallback: if product misses CSV date by >10 business days, we offer 1-month free extension instead of prorate. Can we agree?
Mia Chen: That fallback narrows the negotiation. Finance — prefer prorate, but can accept 1-month extension if we tighten the min-spend clause.
AJ Patel: Fine with 1-month extension as contingency if we get a 25% committed spend threshold. I'll include that in the scenarios.
Priya Singh: I'll prepare the amendment draft with the credit line, acceptance checklist, trainer tentative dates, and the product delivery milestone. Share to legal + finance for sign-off.
legal-bot: Drafting addendum now; will drop language and suggested clause edits in the thread in ~4 hours.
Mia Chen: Thanks all. Once legal and finance sign off I'll send to procurement and request countersignature + PO. :thumbsup:
